task_description: Build a professional next-gen audio reactive visualizer as a commercial-grade desktop application using Electron, React, TypeScript, Three.js, WebGL2, and Web Audio API. The application features a modular architecture with separate audio analysis engine, GPU-accelerated render pipeline, 12+ visualizer modes, cinematic camera system, GPU particle engine, modular shader system, preset management, streaming/OBS support, and a futuristic cyberpunk UI.

verification.summary: TypeScript strict mode passes, Vite build produces 90 modules (757KB JS bundle), all 71 tests pass across 6 test files. Tests cover real algorithmic logic (frequency analysis, beat detection, particle physics, performance monitoring).
